confirmedSoftwareGaps: The official successful job-seeker login defaults to the www.zhipin.com root main-frame landing, which the manual route policy rejected.
Denied-event deduplication omitted phase and could hide a later redirect denial after an earlier resource validation denial.
Idle connection cleanup was logged as a failed network request even after observed requests had completed.
changes: Allow only owned manual main-frame GET/HEAD to https://www.zhipin.com/ without a query or fragment; automatic reads and other root resource types retain their previous permissions.
Include phase in route-denial deduplication. Quota feedback stays one per quota code.
Use fixed login-landing and restricted-landing categories without storing URL parameters or private response content.
Classify idle tunnel closure as cleanup/completed. Connection handshakes and actual request error callbacks retain transport failure semantics.
